description: React component for displaying user seat license alerts in the Mattermost admin console, including logic for dismissing alerts and calculating license usage thresholds.

classes.name: UserSeatAlertBanner
classes.description: React functional component that displays license seat usage alerts based on license data and user count.

methods.name: getPreferenceName
methods.description: Determines the preference key based on license usage percentage and location.

methods.name: calculatePercentUsed
methods.description: Calculates the percentage of license seats used based on total users and license data.

methods.name: handleDismiss
methods.description: Handles dismissing the alert and saving the preference to prevent future display.
